title: Compression of Emotion in Language Model Representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.08683v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have been evaluated on their ability to identify emotions expressed in text and produce fluent emotional language. However, output predictions alone do not reveal how fine-grained emotion distinctions are organized internally. We study seven LLMs on GoEmotions, an English Reddit dataset annotated with 27 fine-grained emotion categories plus neutral. We compare model predictions and emotion-prompted final-token representations with the 28 GoEmotions categories and with coarser emotion-family and sentiment groupings.   We find a consistent pattern of $\textit{overcompression}$ relative to the fine-grained GoEmotions taxonomy. Under the tested KMeans protocol, when we cluster their hidden representations without using emotion labels, the clearest split is into two groups that largely separate positive from negative emotion. Coarser emotion groupings are also recovered with fewer clusters than the full 28-categor

translated_title: 语言模型表示中的情感压缩
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在识别文本中表达的情感以及生成流畅情感语言的能力方面已被广泛评估。然而，仅凭输出预测无法揭示细粒度的情感区分是如何在其内部组织的。我们在GoEmotions数据集上研究了七个大语言模型，该数据集是一个英语Reddit语料库，标注了27个细粒度情感类别外加中性类别。我们将模型预测以及由情感提示得到的末位标记（final-token）表示与GoEmotions的28个类别，以及更粗粒度的情感家族和情感极性分组进行了比较。我们发现，相对于细粒度的GoEmotions分类体系，模型表现出一致的“过度压缩”模式。在所测试的KMeans协议下，当我们不使用情感标签对其隐藏表示进行聚类时，最清晰的划分是分为两组，大体上将积极情感与消极情感区分开来。更粗粒度的情感分组也能用比完整的28个类别更少的聚类数恢复出来。
tldr: 该研究通过对七个大语言模型在GoEmotions数据集上的隐藏表示进行无标签聚类分析，发现模型内部对情感的编码存在“过度压缩”现象——其最清晰的情感区分仅为积极与消极两大类，远粗于28个细粒度情感类别。
en_tdlr: The study shows that hidden representations of seven LLMs exhibit a consistent "overcompression" of emotion, with unsupervised clustering most clearly separating only positive from negative emotion, far coarser than the 28 fine-grained GoEmotions categories.
